rationale: The stock is trading significantly above its session VWAP ($15.17 vs $14.82) and 9-EMA ($14.70) following an 8% gap-up, indicating that the initial momentum has already been priced in. With no specific news catalyst to sustain the move and the price stalling below the intraday high, the risk/reward for entering long is poor due to the high probability of a mean reversion pullback, while shorting into a high-volume gap-up trend carries significant risk of further upside continuation.
